response.justification: While Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software engineering skills and experience with performance-critical systems (e.g., low-latency apps, hardware development), his background lacks direct experience with SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or hardware-software co-design—core requirements for this role. His expertise in web/mobile development and embedded systems does not align closely enough with the Principal Performance Architect focus on cloud infrastructure and AI hardware optimization.
strengths: Extensive experience in performance-critical systems (e.g., low-latency apps, high-throughput microservices)
Strong background in software/hardware development (robotic arms, embedded systems)
Proven track record of optimizing complex systems (pricing strategies, AI-agent infrastructure)
concerns: No documented experience with SoC/IP modeling or AI accelerator architecture
Lacks explicit experience with deep-learning workload optimization or GPU architecture
Background heavily weighted toward software engineering rather than hardware performance or AI hardware optimization
